Run verification command

Usage:
  paw verify [flags]

Examples:
  paw gather --instruction "fix the failing test" | paw compress | paw plan | paw edit | paw verify
  paw edit < .paw/plan.json | paw verify > .paw/verified.json

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for verify

Global Flags:
      --config string       config file
      --log-format string   log format: text, json (default "text")
      --log-level string    log level: debug, info, warn, error (default "info")
      --no-color            disable colored stderr output
      --trace-file string   trace file
      --verbose             verbose output
